experiments.question: Can unconstrained macro discovery manufacture apparent emergence on causally null data?
experiments.method: 500 repetitions; X uniform over 8 microstates; Y independent binary; search all 254 nonconstant binary macro mappings on N=64 training samples for maximum MI(M;Y); evaluate frozen selected mapping on N=5000 independent samples.
experiments.interpretation: Same-data macro selection produces nontrivial false apparent macro information under a null; held-out evaluation collapses it toward zero.

experiments.question: Does held-out evaluation preserve a real stable macro relation?
experiments.method: Same search procedure but Y generated from a fixed true binary macro partition of 8 microstates with 10% label noise.
experiments.interpretation: A stable macro relation survives held-out evaluation while the null overfit does not in this authored test.

experiments.question: Can joint interventional information distinguish higher-order synergy from single-source causation?
experiments.interpretation: A joint-over-best-single interventional information control cleanly distinguishes authored XOR synergy from a pure single-source mechanism; it is a heuristic control, not a substitute for PID/PEID.

experiments.question: Can observational dependence be separated from intervention-sensitive causal influence?
experiments.method: Latent binary common driver C causes A,B,Y; A/B each have 10% noise; compare observational MI((A,B);Y) with randomized do(A,B) while Y remains caused only by C.
experiments.interpretation: Large observational dependence vanishes under intervention in the authored common-driver system.

experiments.question: Does truthful re-entry outperform shuffled/no re-entry when the downstream task genuinely requires the re-entered information?
experiments.interpretation: The intervention detects a deliberately causal re-entry path; it does not prove FRANK re-entry is causal.

negative_result: No synthetic test establishes live FRANK emergence, consciousness, or that any particular macro abstraction is privileged.
next_discriminator: Frozen H1 Ubuntu episodes with preregistered macro definitions, held-out intervention evaluation, matched pairwise/micro controls, lesion/rescue, truthful/shuffled/no re-entry, OOD transfer and cost/recovery shadows.
